TASK: AMS1117-3.3 LDO with input/output decoupling

Build an AMS1117-3.3 linear regulator: +5V feeds C1 (10uF) and pin VI;
pin VO feeds C2 (22uF) and +3V3; pin GND ties to the GND rail. Work inside
the schematic at C:/Users/FlowUP/AppData/Local/Temp/kam-agent-model_ldo-pnahdtpy/ldo.kicad_sch, in a project created at C:/Users/FlowUP/AppData/Local/Temp/kam-agent-model_ldo-pnahdtpy named ldo.

NOTES:
Regulator_Linear:AMS1117-3.3 pin offsets from its own symbol origin:
pin 1 GND at (x, y + 7.62); pin 2 VO at (x + 7.62, y); pin 3 VI at
(x - 7.62, y). Device:C pin 1 sits at (x, y - 3.81), pin 2 at
(x, y + 3.81). Layout, every coordinate already a 1.27mm-grid multiple:
  U1 at (101.60, 88.90)  -> VI (93.98, 88.90)  VO (109.22, 88.90)  GND (101.60, 96.52)
  C1 at (86.36, 92.71)   -> pins at (86.36, 88.90) and (86.36, 96.52)
  C2 at (116.84, 92.71)  -> pins at (116.84, 88.90) and (116.84, 96.52)
Wire C1's top pin to U1's VI pin, C2's top pin to U1's VO pin, and both
capacitors' bottom pins to U1's GND pin along one rail. Anchor +5V at C1's
top pin, +3V3 at C2's top pin, and GND at U1's GND pin, each with its own
power symbol.
